_comment: A TEMPLATE, not a recommendation. Clew ships no opinion about what your
event types mean or which of them should stop work — that is yours to
author and yours to defend. The names below are illustrative.
blocking: a fact of this type, in effect, stops the build.
clearing: a fact of this type releases it. For each subject the LATEST
fact in effect decides, so a reinstatement after a withdrawal wins.
A type in neither list is inert here. That is fine and often right — a
log holds many facts that are not gate decisions.
